area: SOC review: admin access (RBAC) and logging (telemetry) across ZIA, ZPA, Client Connector, ZDX and ZIdentity (soc_review.py, static/report_soc_review.html, /api/soc-review/*, the MCP tools rbac_review and telemetry_review)
title: Wave 10: a dedicated, read-only SOC review of who can administer the tenant and what it streams, with unknown never reported as a pass

checks.what: The RBAC review lists each product's admins with full, limited or read-only rights; ZDX admins come from ZIdentity entitlements
A local ZPA admin without a second factor is Fix; disabled admins still holding rights are Fix; a full-access API key is Review
More than three enabled full-access admins in a product is Review; three is As recommended
What the API does not report (second factor, last sign-in, ZDX streaming) and INFO or ERROR check results are Unknown or N/A, never a pass
The telemetry review names disabled feeds, unhealthy NSS servers, missing ZIA and ZPA log types and products with nothing streamed
A Cloud NSS feed's token, URL path and query, headers and secret fields never reach the answer: the destination is the host name only
Only ticked services are read (the review client refuses the others without a request) and has no write method; Stop ends the review
Both start routes refuse a selection with nothing they read before any client is built; another report kind's id is a 404
The MCP tools rbac_review and telemetry_review are registered read-only and non-destructive, take no secret, number admins instead of naming them and refuse what the server scope does not tick
